orderDevices.fulfillmentWarehouseHelp: Only available devices in this fulfillment's warehouse are shown. To use another warehouse, cancel this unshipped fulfillment and create a new fulfillment from the target warehouse.
orderDevices.dialogHelp: Select devices already in stock, then confirm to save. Closing this dialog leaves the allocation unchanged.
orderDevices.replacementRequired: Select a replacement for each device being changed before saving.
orderDevices.stockOnlyHelp: Allocate only available devices already registered in stock. If a device is missing, register intake first, then return to this order.
orderDevices.iphoneIdentityHelp: Enter the serial number and at least one of IMEI 1, IMEI 2 or EID. IMEI: 15 digits; EID: 32 digits.
orderDevices.noItems: This order has no items that can be allocated.
orderDevices.identifierHelp: Existing numbers use the device already in stock. New numbers are recorded with this allocation using existing inventory.
orderDevices.help: Allocate devices, create fulfillments and ship from this order. Unshipped devices can be released and reallocated.
orderDevices.splitHelp: Select devices from one warehouse or supplier. Create separate fulfillments for different sources.

deviceScan.editHelp: The serial number cannot be changed. Order-linked allocation fields follow the order workflow.
deviceScan.editInvalidCost: Enter a non-negative cost with at most two decimal places.
deviceScan.scannerMultiHelp: Scan serial, IMEI 1, IMEI 2 and EID together (up to four codes). All four are filled automatically, or apply detected values earlier. Scan one device at a time and review before submitting.
deviceScan.scannerFieldHelp: Aim at the barcode or QR code for this field. A matching identifier fills this field immediately. Uploading a complete label can still read multiple identifiers.
deviceScan.scannerWrongField: Wrong identifier type. Scan serial, 15-digit IMEI and 32-digit EID into their respective fields.
deviceScan.labelTextHelp: Read the iPhone model, capacity and English color from the label to prefill SKU search. Verify the details and choose a SKU.
deviceScan.labelTextNotFound: No clear product text found. Search for the SKU manually. Detected identifiers are still available.
deviceScan.labelTextError: Product text could not be read. Search for the SKU manually. Detected identifiers are still available.
deviceScan.scannerConflict: Conflicting, extra or unrecognized codes were found. Existing values were kept. Review serial, IMEI 1, IMEI 2 and EID.
deviceScan.radioSlotsFull: Both identifier fields are filled. Clear the field you want to replace before scanning.
deviceScan.radioDuplicate: The two IMEIs must be different
deviceScan.intakeChooseWarehouse: Select an own warehouse to register intake.
deviceScan.intakeImeiRequired: iPhone intake requires at least one IMEI (15 digits) or EID (32 digits).
deviceScan.imeiHint: 15-digit IMEI. Enter at least one IMEI or EID.
deviceScan.loadError: Unable to load devices. Make sure you are signed in.
deviceScan.requestLoadError: Unable to load after-sales requests for this order.
deviceScan.commandError: Operation failed. Check the details and try again.
deviceScan.skuSearchHelp: Separate filters with spaces, in any order; use only the ones you need. i14pm = iPhone 14 Pro Max, 128 = 128GB, 85 = 85% battery, s = grade S. Colors accept English or Chinese.
deviceScan.skuSearchError: Could not load SKUs. Please retry.
deviceScan.skuSearchEmpty: No matching SKUs. Remove or change a filter.
deviceScan.csvSize: Import file must be smaller than 5 MB.
deviceScan.title: Device intake & dispatch
deviceScan.subtitle: One record per device · Warehouse and supplier shipping · Intake, allocation, shipping, after-sales and resale
deviceScan.orderPlaceholder: Order ID (order_…), or open from the order details
deviceScan.sourceCreated: Supply source created and linked to the default sales channel.
deviceScan.inventoryEnabled: Device management is enabled for this SKU.
deviceScan.takeoverWarning: Taking over resets this SKU's quantity stock to zero, then rebuilds stock from warehouse devices and supplier availability. Existing order reservations must be resolved first. Review before proceeding.
deviceScan.takeoverConfirm: I have reviewed current stock and agree to switch to device inventory.
deviceScan.takeoverSuccess: Device inventory enabled. Register physical devices or supplier quantities.
deviceScan.supplierHelp: Enter supplier units that have not been registered as individual devices. Registered devices are counted separately. Setting the same quantity again does not add stock twice.
deviceScan.intakeHelp: Standard intake makes the device available and adds saleable stock.
deviceScan.csvHelp: In the XLSX template, search and select a complete specification in SKU Parameters. SKU fills automatically and is locked. Type model, storage, color, grade or battery keywords, press Enter, then reopen the parameter dropdown to choose a match. Search terms alone cannot be imported. Leave parameters blank to use the SKU selected above. Grade and battery default to the SKU configuration. Identifiers are formatted as text. Chinese, English and legacy column names are supported. Download a new template after SKU changes.
deviceScan.csvTemplate: Download XLSX template with SKU dropdown
deviceScan.batchSuccess: All devices received and awaiting inspection.
deviceScan.replacementLabel: Original sale for replacement (leave blank for normal allocation)
deviceScan.supplierAllocated: Supplier device registered and allocated to the order.
deviceScan.allocateHelp: Scan or select an available device below, then allocate it. Devices from different sources can be shipped in separate batches.
deviceScan.released: Allocation released. Choose another device. Any existing fulfillment was canceled; its other devices remain allocated and need a new fulfillment.
deviceScan.changePackedHelp: Release, then allocate another device. The entire fulfillment is canceled and stock restored; other devices stay allocated and need a new fulfillment.
deviceScan.fulfillmentCreated: Order fulfillment created and stock deducted. Enter tracking details to ship.
deviceScan.shipSuccess: Devices and order fulfillment marked as shipped.
deviceScan.cancelSuccess: Fulfillment canceled and stock restored. Devices remain allocated; release them or create fulfillment again.
deviceScan.reviewHelp: Review and process customer requests here after submission.
deviceScan.scanReturned: Scan the serial number / IMEI / EID of the device received back.
deviceScan.receivedSuccess: Device verified and received back, awaiting inspection. The order return is synced; no refund has been issued yet.
deviceScan.pass: Pass (restock return / repaired device awaits customer return)
deviceScan.returnSupplier: Return to original supplier, do not restock
deviceScan.inspectionSaved: Inspection saved. Available stock updated based on the result.
deviceScan.repairReturned: Repaired original device returned to the customer. Tracking saved.
deviceScan.refundHelp: Select the return request above and receive all devices, then check the remaining captured balance and refund amount. Confirmation issues a real refund through the order's original payment provider.
deviceScan.refundConfirm: I have checked the request, returned devices and amount, and confirm this refund.
deviceScan.refundSuccess: Refund issued and linked to the after-sales request. Close the request after inspection is complete.
deviceScan.searchPlaceholder: Serial number / IMEI / EID / Device ID
deviceScan.imageIntakeHelp: Choose a clear image of one device label to read its serial number, IMEIs, EID and product details. Review the identifiers and choose the matching SKU before registering intake.
deviceScan.cameraIntakeHelp: Scan one device label with the live camera, or enter an identifier using a barcode scanner. The camera collects serial, IMEI 1, IMEI 2 and EID. Apply detected values when ready, then review and submit.
deviceScan.cameraFieldHelp: Aim the camera at the barcode or QR code for this field. A matching identifier fills the field immediately.
deviceScan.scanCameraHttps: Live scanning requires HTTPS with a trusted certificate, or http://localhost:9001 on this computer. You can also use a barcode scanner or enter identifiers manually.
deviceScan.scanCameraUnsupported: This browser does not provide camera access. Use Safari or Chrome, a barcode scanner, or enter identifiers manually.
deviceScan.scanCameraError: Unable to open the camera: {{message}}. Check camera permissions and close other apps using it, or use a barcode scanner.
deviceScan.cameraHttps: Live scanning requires HTTPS with a trusted certificate. On this computer, you can also open the admin at http://localhost:9001/app. On a phone, use the HTTPS camera address shown at startup and trust its certificate. You can still upload a label photo or enter the identifier manually.
deviceScan.cameraUnsupported: This browser does not provide camera access. Open this page in Safari or Chrome, or upload a label photo.
deviceScan.cameraPermission: Camera access was blocked. Allow camera access in this site's browser settings, then try again.
deviceScan.cameraNotFound: No camera was found on this device. Connect a camera, upload a label photo or enter the identifier manually.
deviceScan.cameraBusy: The camera is unavailable or in use. Close other apps using it and try again, or upload a label photo.
deviceScan.imageError: No usable identifier or product information detected. Upload a clear photo of the complete label or enter the details manually.
deviceScan.scannerHelp: Supports label barcodes and QR codes. Scanning fills the fields; review them before submitting.
deviceScan.manualInput: Enter serial number, IMEI or EID manually
deviceScan.manualPlaceholder: Enter manually or use a barcode scanner
deviceScan.openWorkspace: Open device intake & dispatch: allocate, ship and inspect returns
deviceScan.csvHeaders: Import headers are missing, unrecognized or map to the same field. Use the template's Chinese or English column names.
deviceScan.csvIdentity: Import requires a Serial Number, IMEI, IMEI 2 or EID column. Keep identifiers formatted as text.
deviceScan.csvSku: SKU on row {{row}} was not found or conflicts with variant_id.
deviceScan.csvColumns: Row {{row}} contains values without matching headers.
deviceScan.cameraError: Unable to open camera: {{message}}. Check permissions, upload a label photo or enter manually.
deviceScan.batchPreview: {{count}} devices ready to import. Review the preview before submitting. If any row is invalid, the entire batch is rejected.

deviceScan.supplierScope: Supplier account: view your own devices, maintain availability, and register, allocate and ship devices for authorized orders.
deviceScan.supplierAccountHelp: Create a dedicated supplier account with an email, supplier, authorized orders and a password of at least 12 characters. Restrictions apply immediately. Leave the password empty to update an existing account. Saving replaces authorized orders; clear them to revoke order operations.
deviceScan.supplierOrdersHelp: Enter order IDs (order_…), one per line or separated by commas.
deviceScan.supplierPassword: New account password (leave empty for existing accounts)
deviceScan.supplierPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters for a new account
deviceScan.batchSkuHelp: Check the SKU code shown for every device before confirming. Rows with a blank SKU use the current selection above.
deviceScan.importFormula: Only the template's automatic SKU formula is supported. Replace other formulas with values before importing.
deviceScan.importSkuParameters: Row {{row}} has an incomplete or invalid SKU parameter selection, or its SKU does not match. Select a complete specification from the template dropdown.
deviceScan.templateSkuPrompt: Search without spaces (e.g. iphone14256gbgradea85%), press Enter, then reopen this dropdown and select the complete specification. SKU fills automatically.
deviceScan.templateSkuError: Select a complete specification from SKU Parameters, or leave it blank.
deviceScan.photosHelp: Optional, up to 8 JPG, PNG or WebP photos. Photos are compressed automatically.
deviceScan.saleIntakeHelp: Standard intake makes the device available and adds saleable stock.
deviceScan.reviewIntakeHelp: Returned and recycled devices await inspection without adding saleable stock. Passing inspection moves them to sale devices.
deviceScan.deleteConfirm: Soft delete device {{serial}}? Device records and audit history are retained. Available stock will decrease.
deviceScan.retireConfirm: Retire device {{serial}}? Available stock will decrease.

mobileIntake.title: Temporary mobile intake
mobileIntake.help: The owned warehouse is selected automatically. Create an independent mobile page valid for two hours. Anyone with the link can receive devices into this warehouse. Share it only with receiving staff.
mobileIntake.origin: Backend address reachable by phone (HTTPS for camera)
mobileIntake.originError: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address
mobileIntake.create: Create temporary link and QR code
mobileIntake.copyError: Select and copy the link manually
mobileIntake.failed: Could not create link. Please retry.
